crossSetNotes.A: one object per story carried through three states: cheapest and most placeable set; some companion lines repeat ('the X is talking').
crossSetNotes.B: apprentices cause the change in most stories (Tally, Tam, Puddle, Mirra, Ashe, Nix, Bunk, Mote); most varied; a few chapters exceed one prop.
crossSetNotes.C: every ch1 is 'the resident found your grassling asleep' and every join line ends 'an Nth stone lights' (numbering matches cast.md's table): coherent but repetitive across 11 stories; apprentices often have one line.
